requirement.normalizedRequirement: MDLT_degC shall be calculated from daily low temperatures over data_period_years >= 10; if data_period_years < 10, administration_dataset_approval_status shall be valid.
requirement.requiredInputs: Daily low-temperature dataset, coverage period, and approval evidence when applicable
requirement.source: International Code for Ships Operating in Polar Waters (Polar Code)
requirement.sourceText: Mean Daily Low Temperature (MDLT) means the mean value of the daily low temperature for each day of the year over a minimum 10 year period. A data set acceptable to the Administration may be used if 10 years of data is not available.

semanticObligations: A ship has dated dailyLowTemperatureObservation nodes carrying dailyLowTemperature values, a dataPeriod, and a meanDailyLowTemperature result. If dataPeriod is shorter than 10 years, administrationDatasetApprovalStatus is evidenceStateApproved. The complete aggregation is external and is not reconstructed in SHACL.
